title: Keep Your Way Pure
truth: God's Word helps us live a pure life because Jesus makes us pure and forgiven.
points: God's Word shows us how to live pure
Jesus makes our hearts pure and clean
We can choose to follow God's Word
apply: Today, read a Bible story or listen to a worship song to hide God's Word in your heart and remember Jesus' love.
prayer: God, thank You for Your Word that helps me live pure, and thank You, Jesus, for making my heart clean.
